title: 31 Years Later, Legendary Isekai Reboot Reveals First Look at Crunchyroll Premiere
content:
A legendary Isekai anime franchise is coming back to screens with a new anime on Crunchyroll after three decades, and now fans have gotten a first loom at what to expect from its big premiere. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are about to see a whole new wave of releases to keep an eye out for over the next few weeks. While there are some brand new shows that are definitely worth watching, there’s one major franchise returning for a brand new take on its classic story.

CLAMP’s Magic Knight Rayearth series is coming back with a brand new reboot anime series taking on the classic from the very beginning , and that means a whole new generation of fans will be able to check it out for the first time. Now as the anime gears up for its premiere in just a few more days, Magic Knight Rayearth has revealed the first look trailer for its first episode and you can check it out below.

Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot Confirms Episode 1 Release Date

Magic Knight Rayearth Episode 1 is titled “From Another World” and will be making its debut on Wednesday, October 7th in Japan. Crunchyroll will be exclusively streaming the reboot episodes as they make their premiere as part of their jam packed Fall 2026 anime schedule. They have also announced plans to release an English dubbed version of the reboot, but no release schedule has been set just yet. And with the first look at its premiere episode, the reboot doesn’t seem to be drifting too far away from the original.

As for what to expect from the premiere itself, Magic Knight Rayearth teases more of the classic Isekai set up for its main trio, “Middle school student Hikaru Shidou, who visits Tokyo Tower for a social studies field trip, is drawn into another dimension along with Umi Ryuzaki from another school and Fuu Hououji. What awaited the three was a world unlike any they had ever seen――.” But with Isekai being such a bigger deal these days , this reboot has a much better chance at success than it ever had before.

What’s New for Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot?

This new version of Magic Knight Rayearth is directed by Yui Miura for E&H Production ( Ninja Kamui, Bullet/Bullet ) with Kadokawa and TMS Entertainment overseeing its production. Shigeru Murakoshi is handling the scripts with Satomi Watabe handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura, Takumi Ozawa and Shiho Terada composing the music. But everything about this new take thus far doesn’t seem to be straying too far away from CLAMP’s classic story .

There are quite a few new Isekai anime releases to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year, but make sure to keep an eye on this one. Though it might be a reboot of a classic series, it’s going to have a story that fits in perfectly with the modern era. Fans love Isekai anime these days, but wait until you see their weapons in action. Are you excited for the Magic Knight Rayearth reboot? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Charisma TV Anime Unveils More Staff, Key Visual
content:
The staff for the television anime of Evil Line Records label ( Hypnosis Mic ) and the intellectual property company Dazed's Chōjin-teki Share House Story Charisma (Superhuman Shared Residence Story: Charisma) project revealed on Sunday a new key visual along with more staff members.

The newly announced staff include:

• Character Design: Haru Watanabe

• Chief Animation Directors: Haru Watanabe, HANSEUNGAH

• Art Director: Seiki Tamura

• Color Key Artist: Yukiko Kakita

• Compositing Director of Photography: Tōru Fukushi

• Editor: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Music: Gesshoku Kaigi

• Sound Directors: Kyōko Wada, Shū Matsubara

• Sound Production: Rakuonsha

• Producers: Kotaro Sudo, Sōichiro Hirano, Yoshihiro Tominaga

Evil Line Records and Dazed launched the original project in 2021, and the project revolves around 2D characters who embody "charisma" — in the original sense of the term, which means divinely gifted elemental traits. They stay in a share house (a residence with some shared facilities, such as the kitchen) while aspiring for even higher goals.

The project's cast includes:

• Katsumi Fukuhara as Iori Motohashi, the charisma of obedience

• Genki Okawa as Terra, the charisma of self-love

• Masahiro Yamanaka as Rikai Kusanagi, the charisma of order

• Kenta Hosoda as Kei Sarukawa, the charisma of rebellion

• Saku Hyūga as Ohse Minato, the charisma of internal punishment

• Tomohisa Hashizume as Amahiko Tendō, the charisma of sex

• Yūki Ono as Fumiya Itō, the charisma of good and evil

Jōji Furuta ( Bad Girl , ēlDLIVE , Utano☆Princesama Legend Star , 2021 Shaman King ) is directing the anime at Pierrot Films . Original creator Shū Matsubara is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Evil Line Records is in charge of music. Along with Matsubara, Dazed is credited for the original work, and Ebimo is credited for the original character designs. TBS Television is the production manager.

The anime will debut in January 2027 on TBS .

The project has already spawned musical releases and live concerts. Rin Manda and Iori Irino serialized the four-panel manga Charisma: Kyō mo Heiwa Desu in Kodansha 's Dessert magazine in January 2023 to December 2024 with two volumes compiled, and Sō Tobita serialized the Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai-chū manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days site from February to December 2023 with two volumes compiled.

title: Spooky Shonen Jump Anime Drops New Season 2 Look Just in Time for Halloween
content:
Halloween is right around the corner as the Fall 2026 anime season is dropping all the new shows. It’s the final quarter of the year and possibly the biggest one so far thanks to the return of major shows such as Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and more. While fans are busy with the exciting series of the season, a lot of upcoming series are also dropping new information in the meantime. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have always released some of the most exceptional series in the industry. The monthly magazine Jump Square falls within the category as it includes monthly Shonen manga series across all genres, including action, horror, and more.

One such series is Dark Gathering , an underrated horror manga written and illustrated by Kenichi Kondo. While the manga began serialization in 2019, it’s nowhere near its finale. On the other hand, an anime adaptation premiered in 2023, and it’s all set to return with a new season. Since spooky season is finally here, Dark Gathering dropped a new visual to hype fans for its return. The official X handle of Pony Canyon Anime shares the visual while confirming it features Kubizuka Daimyojin, a shrine that can be seen in the middle of eerie mist.

Does Dark Gathering Season 2 Have a Release Date?

The anime is all set to return in 2027 , but so far an exact release date hasn’t been confirmed yet. However, fans can expect new updates during Jump Festa 2027, which is scheduled to be held on December 20th and 21st. Jump Festa is the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, as it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. As confirmed on Jump Festa’s official website , Dark Gathering will be holding a panel during the event’s Jump Studio stage.

Fans might get an official key visual or even a teaser, along with more updates during the event. Since the manga runs on a monthly schedule, the anime took four years to return so that the animation studio would have enough chapters for another season. We can expect the series to return to HIDIVE, where you can catch up with the first season. Furthermore, the anime is now also available on Prime Video, but fans still can’t find it on Crunchyroll or Netflix.

Dark Gathering Season 2 Will Be More Intense Than Ever

Among Shonen Jump series, Dark Gathering is known for its gritty details and gory visuals that aren’t suited for the faint of heart. Before the second season’s episode count is revealed, it’s impossible to determine how many chapters or arcs the anime will cover. The first season released 25 episodes, but there’s always a chance the sequel will return with only one cour that spans 12 to 13 episodes. The story follows Keitaro Gentoga, who wants to put his supernatural abilities behind him and live a normal life as a college student. However, his life takes a drastic turn when he meets Yayoi, a girl with similar supernatural abilities.

He soon finds himself entangled in her mission of capturing and enslaving violent spirits to prepare for battle against the spirit that stole the soul of Yayoi’s mother. The first season adapted 34 chapters from the manga, which means the sequel will at least wrap up the Kyoto Arc , where Yayoi, Keitaro, and Eiko travel to Kyoto to confront dangerous new ghosts and mysterious state-made gods. We can also expect the story to get even more intense with the introduction of more powerful monsters with unique abilities.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Just Gave Asta a Powerful New Sword
content:
Black Clover has officially made its return to screens with Season 2 of the anime, and with it has kicked things off by giving Asta a powerful new sword. Black Clover has finally made its return after five long years with a brand new season of the anime , and it’s picking up right from where it all left off. Asta and the Clover Kingdom’s Magic Knights have been in the midst of training to face off against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad, and now it’s finally time for the raid.

Black Clover Season 2 is now adapting the long awaited Spade Kingdom Raid arc as the Clover Kingdom makes their way into the Spade Kingdom with the hopes of stopping the Dark Triad’s Advent of Qliphoth ritual. But while the others are getting a head start, Asta needs a little more time to train with his newly unlocked Devil abilities (together with Liebe ). Including the use of a brand new sword, which he names the Demon-Slasher Katana.

Black Clover Season 2 Premiere Introduces Asta’s Demon-Slasher Katana

Black Clover Season 2’s premiere episode puts fans right back into the cliffhanger that the debut season ended off on back in 2021. Asta is still in the midst of training to better work together with Liebe, and the two of them are trying their best to master the Devil Union transformation that Nacht already has a full mastery of. But during all of this, Asta has also started to use a new (but familiar weapon) now stored within his grimoire, the Demon-Slasher Katana, which is the final memento that he has from his fight alongside Captain Yami before.

Yami’s katana has now been fully absorbed into Asta’s grimoire, and has thus been coated with Anti-Magic. Now that it’s a part of Asta’s weapon repertoire, it’s going to be key in the fights against the Dark Triad to come. We’ve yet to see what kind of new power he’s going to have at his disposal in the anime series itself when he’s fully mastered his training, though promotional materials and even the opening for the series have revealed this form and weapon in action . It won’t be too much longer before we see Asta rejoin the fight.

How to Watch Black Clover Season 2

Black Clover Season 2 is now back in action after five years of waiting , and new episodes will be released on a weekly basis through the rest of the Fall. If you wanted to catch them as they air in Japan, the new episodes will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia. There’s an English dub planned for the new season too, but any release information has yet to be revealed for it as this time.

Black Clover Season 2 has yet to reveal how long it’s going to run for, but it’s likely not going to be for that long . There’s no way it’s going to get anywhere near the massive 170 episode long order seen with the first season, and with only two arcs from Yuki Tabata’s original manga series left, there’s just not much ground left to cover. But what are you hoping to see from Asta in Black Clover Season 2? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Digimon Reunites Its Classic DigiDestined With Epic Crossover – Watch Now
content:
Digimon has kicked off a massive celebration for the franchise’s 30th anniversary, and with it has reunited most of its classic DigiDestined with a cool crossover to show them all off. Digimon has entered a new era of the franchise as while it marks 30 years since the digital pet toys first started making their way to shelves, the TV anime has also recently ended its latest franchise entry. With Digimon Beatbreak airing its final episodes this Summer , it’s now time to look ahead to the future of the long running series.

Digimon is now in the midst of celebrating its 30th anniversary in Japan, and it’s doing so with a special remastered broadcast of some of its most classic episodes as voted by fans in the region. But while these are going to be classic episodes shown again, each one has gotten a new opening and ending theme that really goes all out to celebrate the first four generations of the series. You can check them out in action below.

Digimon Celebrates 30th Anniversary With New Anime Crossover

Titled “The Best Adventure We Chose,” Digimon is hosting a special rebroadcast of select episodes as voted by fans in Japan for the franchise’s 30th anniversary. Celebrating the first four iterations of the franchise, Digimon Adventure, Digimon Adventure 02, Digimon Tamers , and Digimon Frontier , you can see them all crossing over in the special opening that even sees some of them using one another’s evolution type. Titled “Shakariki!!,” the new opening theme for the event is performed by Ayumi Miyazaki and Takayoshi Tanimoto.

The two of them are also behind the new ending theme titled “Limitless Dreams,” which also finds a cool way to showcase some of the biggest events from the anime in its earliest days. But with the franchise celebrating so much of the past, it’s also preparing to enter a new era as a brand new project for the series has been announced to be in the works. Which means it won’t be too much longer until Digimon fans get to find out what’s coming next for the anime.

What’s Next for Digimon?

Along with kicking off the 30th anniversary celebration for the franchise, Digimon has also confirmed its plans for the next major entry for the anime. A brand new Digimon anime project has been revealed to be in the works for a release sometime in 2027, but a release date has yet to be announced as of this time. There are still many details yet to be revealed for the project such as its production staff and cast, or even the form it will ultimately take when it premieres. It could be a new movie, TV series, or something else altogether.

Digimon Beatbreak might have capped off its run this year, but it’s clear that the Digimon franchise is showing no signs of slowing down the anime releases anytime soon. There’s a good chance we’ll see more of the new anime revealed whenever this 30th anniversary rebroadcast wraps up its run later this Fall, so definitely keep an eye out for what could be coming next. What do you think of this Digimon crossover? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Manga 'Manshuu Ahen Squad' Gets Anime Adaptation
content:
Publishing company Kodansha opened an official website for an anime adaptation of Tsukasa Monma and Shikako 's Manshuu Ahen Squad ( Manchuria Opium Squad ) manga on Monday.

Monma and Shikako began serializing the historical crime manga on the Comic Days platform in April 2020. It was transferred to Weekly Young Magazine in September 2021.

The series went on hiatus following the death of Shikako in November 2025, but resumed its serialization as per their wishes on October 5, with Tsurushima serving as the new illustrator. Kodansha published the 22nd volume in November 2025. Manshuu Ahen Squad has over 3 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha licensed the series in English through its K Manga service in May 2023. The 14th volume went on sale on September 8th, with the 15th scheduled for a November 10 release.

The series was nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Awards in the general category, and the 70th Shogakukan Manga Awards .

Synopsis "Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life."

In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug—a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown. (Source: Kodansha)

The series was nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Awards in the general category, and the 70th Shogakukan Manga Awards .
Synopsis "Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life."

In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug—a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown. title: New Naruto Live-Action Movie Report Teases Big Changes & Fans Aren’t Happy
content:
Rumors of a Naruto live-action movie have been swirling for years, with some fans saying it would be the best thing to happen to the series since it was released and others claiming it would be impossible to pull off while still doing justice to the 700+ episodes’ worth of story . But impossible or not, Destin Daniel Cretton ( Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings ) believes he’s up to the challenge and has officially been tapped to direct the film. That said, it’s not entirely smooth sailing, as industry insiders say a few changes to the original story are coming.

According to one particular insider , Daniel Richtman, those changes are a good thing. Some fans, however, don’t agree. In an effort to “calm” people down, he tweeted a list of the changes, which includes making Naruto a history nerd (despite him still being a poor student), giving Sakura a more tragic backstory with the passing of her father, and a strained relationship with her mother, as well as toning down her crush on Sasuke (and even giving him a slight crush on her in return). But in an effort to truly assuage fans, Richtman does confirm that the film is slated to be “faithful, with a lot of scenes recreated almost shot-for-shot from the first arc of the manga. The changes are mostly character-related, and they don’t affect the story as much as you might think.”

Will These Changes Actually Make for a Stronger Story?

That depends on who you ask. Referencing Richtman’s claims that the changes are only character-related, one fan asked, “Then why change them? Just keep it like the source material; why is that hard to do? It’s already written and popular.” And it seems that the answer to that question is somewhere in the middle. Adapting a 700+ episode anime into a (potential) handful of films will take a lot of strategic cutting and pasting. Some things simply don’t work on film the same way that they do in animation, or in long-form storytelling.

That doesn’t mean every change will be an automatic win, and fans aren’t wrong to be concerned, especially about changes to Naruto, his personality, and the idea that a Jinchuriki is strictly a bloodline thing; let’s not forget that Gaara had no bloodline connection to Shukaku and was only made a jinchuriki thanks to his father’s experiments on his mother. And as for the changes to Sakura’s character, which essentially feel like an attempt to do away with her early character development, one fan seems to have the perfect solution : “If they wanna avoid Sakura coming across as a damsel, just highlight her strengths early, like her book-smart intellect & perfect chakra control, so she’s a tactical asset. Realizing that her intelligence hits a ceiling next to Naruto and Sasuke is a fundamental aspect of her character.”

Personally, I can see how some changes would translate better to film, but changes to Naruto’s personality and the Jinchuriki’s history never seem like the right move. Are there any changes you’re looking forward to (or dreading)? Drop them in the comments.

title: Manchuria Opium Squad Manga Gets Anime
content:
This year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that writer Tsukasa Monma and late artist Shikako 's Manchuria Opium Squad manga is receiving an anime adaptation.

The manga also resumed serialization in the magazine on Monday, with new artist Tsurushima drawing the manga. Tsurushima was Shikako 's senior colleague while working as assistant for Yasuhisa Hara 's Kingdom manga. The manga resumed with two chapters. The 12-page chapter 216 was originally planned to be 16 pages long. Shikako was able to complete 11 pages before they died. Monma arranged the 12th page, which does not feature any characters, and the assistant(s) who had been supporting Shikako drew the background. From chapter 217, the manga takes a new step with art by Tsurushima.

Kodansha publishes the series in English on the K MANGA service and describes the story:

"Here in Manchuria, the cheapest thing you'll find is a person's life." In 1937, Isamu Higata is sent to the Japan-controlled Chinese puppet state of Manchukuo to serve in its standing army. After losing sight in his right eye during battle, he's banished to an agricultural facility where he's constantly abused by the commanding officers. Then, in a dusty corner, he discovers a field of poppies, the raw materials for opium. In order to raise money for his seriously ill mother, Isamu decides to produce the illicit drug - a choice that sends his future and the fate of all Manchuria into directions unknown.

The manga launched on Kodansha 's Comic Days service from April 2020 to September 2021. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine in September 2021, with its 43rd issue of 2021. Kodansha shipped the 22nd compiled book volume in November 2025.

Shikako died on November 8, 2025 due to choroidal melanoma, a rare form of cancer that develops in the eye. The artist wanted someone to complete the manga series in their place, and the Weekly Young Magazine staff stated then that they would respect Shikako 's wishes.

title: Magical Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms New Sequel After Finale
content:
One major Isekai franchise has just wrapped up a new season with Crunchyroll , and thankfully has already confirmed it’s coming back for even more of the anime. The final few anime of the Summer have aired their respective finales now that the Fall 2026 anime schedule is kicking into high gear , and that has meant saying goodbye to some of the biggest franchises. But thankfully some of these franchises have confirmed that there are plans in place to keep them going with new releases in the near future.

This Summer saw some of the bigger Isekai anime franchises come to an end , and that’s the case for Ascendance of a Bookworm as well. The anime adaptation of Miya Kazuki and You Shiina’s original light novel series has wrapped up its fourth season this Summer, but has already confirmed that more of the TV anime is now in the works with the reveal of a fifth season coming our way. Check out the official announcement below.

Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 5 Announced

Ascendance of a Bookworm has officially announced it’s now working on a new TV anime adaptation for the next big entry in the original light novels, Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4: Founder of the Royal Academy’s So-Called Library Committee . The fourth season of the series wrapped up the TV anime adaptation of the third part with its final episodes this Summer , so it’s time for the next major phase of the story. But unfortunately not much has been revealed about what to expect from the TV anime’s return or when to expect to see the new episodes as of the time of this announcement.

Ascendance of a Bookworm has announced that WIT Studio will once again be overseeing the animation production for the coming season, but no release window or date has been revealed as of the time of this initial announcement. It’s highly likely that the anime will feature a returning production staff and cast as seen through the first four seasons of the anime thus far, but that’s still not totally confirmed. Especially when things got off to a rough start earlier this year.

What’s Happening in Ascendance of a Bookworm?

Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 4 got off to a rather rough start earlier this year as WIT Studio was accused of using AI generated materials for its opening theme sequence. Following this controversy, WIT Studio addressed and corrected the issue for future episodes but it still got the new season off to a rather bad foot at the start. But even with all of that, the series still remains a steadily popular experience that fans want to see more of when the new episodes make their way out.

Regardless of that mix up and controversy early on, Ascendance of a Bookworm was still one of the pillars of fantasy anime releases now streaming with Crunchyroll ( which resulted in a cool crossover with a breakout rookie anime series ). You can catch up with all seasons of the series now streaming with the service in the meantime, and there’s both English and Japanese language audio available as well. But are you excited to see Ascendance of a Bookworm coming back for another season?

title: 'Charisma' Announces Additional Staff
content:
The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of the Charisma House mixed-media project revealed additional staff and a key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series will premiere on TBS affiliate networks in January 2027.

Staff Character Design: Haru Watanabe ( Kawagoe Boys Sing ) Chief Animation Director: Haru Watanabe, Han Seungah ( ēlDLIVE ) Art Director: Seiki Tamura ( Nippon Sangoku ) Color Design: Yukiko Kakita ( Ranma ½ (2024) ) Director of Photography: Susumu Fukushi ( Osomatsu-san ) Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Music: Gesshoku Kaigi ( Back Street Girls: Gokudolls ) Music Production: Evil Line Records Sound Director: Kyoko Wada, Shu Matsubara Sound Production: Rakuonsha Producer: Kotaro Sudo, Soichiro Hidano, Yoshihiro Tominaga ( Akudama Drive )

Jouji Furuta ( Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love Legend Star ) is directing the anime at Pierrot Films , with Shuu Matsubara ( Osomatsu-san ) handling the series composition and script. Shuu Matsubara is in charge of the original story, while Ebimo ( Let's Play: Quest-darake no My Life ) is providing the original character designs.

King Records launched the Charisma House multimedia project under its Evil Line Records label in August 2021. The project includes manga adaptations, music releases, audio dramas, and stage plays.

Rin Manda and Iori Irino serialized a manga adaptation titled Charisma: Kyou mo Heiwa desu in Dessert magazine from January 2023 to December 2024. The second volume went on sale on March 13 last year.

Sou Tobita launched a spin-off manga titled Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai-chu in the Comic DAYS magazine, which ran from February 2023 to December 2023. The second volume was released in February 2024.
